question: Best study spots on campus?
answer:
Five that students keep coming back to:

**[McKeldin Library, upper floors](https://www.lib.umd.edu/visit/libraries/mckeldin)**  
The quiet ones. Undergrads can get their own study carrel on the 3rd, 4th or 6th floor.

**[Edward St. John Learning and Teaching Center](https://provost.umd.edu/resources/esj)**  
Natural light, the Food for Thought café, and outlets everywhere.

**[Iribe Center](https://iribe.umd.edu)**  
Open study on the second floor, and you don't need a reservation.

**[STEM Library](https://www.lib.umd.edu/visit/libraries/stem)**  
A student pick when finals hit.

**[Stamp Student Union, top floor](https://stamp.umd.edu)**  
Another finals favorite, with the food court in the same building.
